metadata.title: Station residual correction checks for Japanese strong-motion records and official hazard spectra
metadata.description: Derived station-level residual tables, official J-SHIS response-spectrum checks, official PSHA input-chain audit files, multi-event KiK-net transfer-function outputs, and scripts supporting the manuscript. Original J-SHIS/NIED products should be obtained from the official provider.
